tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gzhi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i phrin las dgra srog gcod pa'i spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// g.yo can bdud sde'i stobs lcags rang mthu bzhin// sdod pa'i dbang bral sgrub po'i bsam pa'i phyir// khrid nus mū la sa de tsa ri tra'i// gshin rje'i rgyal por bsngags phyir de la 'dud// rtsod pa'i dus mtha' las mtha' phal gyi byin// rengs pa'i dza gad mtshungs gyur de tsa na// pho nya che 'di'i ngan sngags reg gcod kyi// spu gri gzung zhes gshin rje'i gshed po gsung*// 'dir khro bo'i rgyal po ya man ta ka'i thugs las sprul zhing*/ ma traṃ ru tra bsgral ba'i khrag las 'khrungs pa// sa 'og rim pa dgu'i 'og yi dwags rnams kyi khab na chos kyi rgyal po mdzad pa/ khyad par bdud dga' rab dbang phyug chung ma pad+ma'i phreng ba can blon po bzhi dang bcas pa/ lnga brgya tha ma nye ba| sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ches bar du gcod pa dag sgrol ba'i ging chen por dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur zhing*/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyis nus pa byin pa/ lho phyogs kyi dur khrod 'jigs byed tsa ri tra cig car dpal gyi nags tshal/ gshin yul dme nag skyi g.ya' ba gnas dang*/ zangs mkhar gru gsum pho brang du gtad nas phyogs skyong chen por mnga' gsol ba/ 'dod pa la chags pa'i mgon po dmar po| /rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal dang*/ ri ma la gnam lcags rgyun du 'bab pa la sogs par las kyi pho nya ci car yang rdzu ba de sgrub par 'dod pas/ dkyil 'khor dang rten rdzas la sogs pa tshogs par byas nas/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi lhar bltas te/ mchod rdzas thams cad swa was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ las thod pa'i snod dam mkha'i khyon tsam pa'i nang du/ ā las dgyes pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas ma tshang ba med pa rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil ba/ hūm̐ las thams cad kyang ye shes kyi rol pa chen po zad mi shes pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dhar+m+māḥswa bhā wa shud+dhā&haṃ/

snang srid thams cad me ri smug nag tu 'bar zhing*/ rlung nag po spu gri can 'tshub cing 'khyil ba'i khrod/ thod pa 'bar ba'i lcags ri'i dbung*/ khrag gi rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa rba rlabs su 'khrug pa'i klong*/ me rlung gi mtshams nas srid pa'i rtse'i bar dmar lhag ge pa'i zangs kyi mkhar gru gsum sgo gcig pa/ nyin dud par 'thul zhing mtshan me 'bar ba/ nang ro myags kyi ljang ba'i gzhir ral gri lo mas gtams pa/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mi sdug pa thams cad kyis skyi g.ya' ba'i dbus gnam lcags mthing nag gi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa thod pa'i mu khyud can gyi lte bar hūm̐/ oṃ shrī man+dzu ya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dza ṭī dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bsgrags pa las/ dpal tsa ri tra'i gshin rje'i rgyal po shin tu zhud pa'i sku/ bskal pa'i me'i bongs dang mdangs su snang ba/ srid pa gsum po lto na chug pa/ gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs nas/ gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs te bskal pa bshol ba'i chu 'bebs pa/ khros pa'i spyan gsum las sreg pa'i me 'bar ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs las 'thor ba'i rlung g.yo ba/ ag tshom sma ra smin ma sha'i ral pa rta gdong gi mes khengs pa lta bu nas gshin rje pho 'bum mo 'bum pho nyar 'gyed pa/ ba spu mtshon cha ngar ma thams cad du snang zhing*/ khong nas dug gi sprin mun pa mun nag tu gtibs pa'i bar bar nas 'od kyi skar mda' rgyug pa'i rtser khro bo khro mo ci yang 'chams stabs su rol ba/ thod pa lnga dang sbrul nag po stong gis brgyan cing*/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba dang snying do shal du 'phyang ba/ las kyi me long thugs khar snang zhing*/ me'i slog pa la rin po che'i ska rags bcings shing srid pa'i khram shing chen po sked du gzer ba/ sho'i rde snod glor btags nas rlung nag 'khrug pa'i ber lhab lhub tu gyon te/ phyag g.yas dmag gi rdzong chen po'i be con 'phyar zhing*/

g.yon ma rungs pa thams cad 'ching pa'i ma tram ru tra'i rgyu ma'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing 'jig rten gsum zil gyis gnon te mā ra ya'i gad rgyang chen pos bdud kyi rgyal po chung ma dang bcas pa kha bub par byas pa'i steng du bzhugs pa'i sta zur g.yon du/ bdud mo tsā muṇ+ḍi dmar nag mi sdug pa'i bzhin gyi rlangs pas nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'gyed cing*/ 'jig rten phung bar byed pa'i dmod pa 'dor ba/ ba spu'i khung nas gdon bgegs dang ltas ngan pa dang ye 'brog thams cad 'phro ba/ 'dod chags kyis gdungs te yab dang 'khril ba don du gnyer ba/ tri shu la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gtso bo spyan shangs| ljags/ thugs ka las phyogs bzhir bdud kyi yang blon bzhi kha bub pa'i steng du dza dang ma re 'phros pa/ shar du 'gugs byed srin po'i ging pra ma ra dza smug nag stag shu dang stag ral can/ ral gri kha mangs 'phyar zhing dgra snying za ba/ badz+ra zom sha ma me'i zhags pa 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ lhor 'ching byed gshin rje'i ging ya ma rā dza mthing nag thod sbrul gyi rgyan dang g.yang gzhi can me rlung gi 'khor lo bzung ste/ badz+ra g.yang gzhi ma rlung gi zhags pa 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ nub tu gsod byed bdud kyi ging da sha gṛ ba sha shu dom slag can/ khram shing dang rtsis sho bsnams te badz+ra da sha ma chu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ byang du za byed gnod sbyin gyi ging yak+ṣa kā la ljang na 'brug shu dang gza' slag can/ be con dang spu gri gzung ste badz+ra phor thogs ma sa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ phyi rol du bka' nyan gyi ging pho mo bye ba dung phyur thams cad kyang mi sdug pa'i gzugs cir yang badzu zhing mtshon cha ci yang khyer ba/ brda mi 'phrod pa gshugs glu 'then zhing srid pa gsum gyi srog la rgyug pa/ bla la dga' ba zas su mi sha dang skom du mi khrag dron mo 'thung pa/

las su srog gcod pa/ dus ma yin pa'i dus dang*/ bskal pa min pa'i bskal pa gtong ba/ gti mug gi rmongs shing 'dod chags kyis gdungs pa/ zhe sdang gi tshig cing nga rgyal gyis brgyal ba/ phrag dog gis 'khrug pa/ 'jig rten gyi las dang rgyu rkyen drag po las grub pa rnams kyi gnas bzhir dzaḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ sa 'og rim pa dgu'i gshin rje'i khab dang*/ rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal/ mā la ya| khyad par lho phyogs kyi dur khrod 'jigs byed chen po tsa ri tra cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs/ gshin yul dme nag nas gzhi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhūm̐| 'jam dpal ya man ta ka yi// thugs kar dpal gyi be'u nang*// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa yin// khro bo rol pas tshogs rjer mchod// lus can kun gyi ltag pa na// nyon mongs las las grub pa'i gshed// 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje shar// khams gsum sems can ma lus za// sngon gyi ru tra'i 'dod chags khrag /legs ldan nyi ma'i bu ru btsas| /gshin rje'i khab kyi rgyal por snang*// gzi brjid chen po'i rdzu 'phrul 'chang*// rgyal bas bdud dgrar 'os gzigs nas// sgrol ging chen por dbar bskur te// gsang sngags dkyil 'khor kun gyi lho'i// 'jigs byed dur khrod tsa rir bzhag /rtsub 'gyur tshal dang mā la yar// ma ru rtser yang badzu ba'i 'khor// gshan pa ma ra khrag skyug sde// 'jig rten khams rnams phung bar byed// de 'dra'i cho 'phrul mi zad pas// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gnyer mdzad pa'i// cig car dmar po khyod 'bod kyis// gzhi bdag 'khor bcas da tshur byon// gshin rigs gdugs pa can gyi drung*// gshin gyi ro lo dmar po thad// gshin rje'i bla mtsho khol ba'i 'gram// gshin lam ro khung 'jigs pa'i khrod// thod pa khrag mtshos bskor ba'i dbus// gru gsum 'bar ba'i zangs khar nang*// ro myags spu gris gtams pa'i gzhi// mthing nag 'khor lo'i dbus nas gshegs// hūm̐|

rten rdzas tshogs pa dam tshig gi /dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas mchog 'dir// phyogs skyong chen po 'khor bcas rnams// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung rol pa'i nus pa'i dpyid// dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba'i// gshin rje'i rgyal po'i 'khor bcas la// dad pas bstod de phyag 'tshal lo// be con can gyi phyag rgya bstan nas/ hūm̐/ khye'u sngon po dpon slob kyis// rdo rje be con byin pa'i dus// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa// de ltar bskul gyis sa ma ya// mnyam med 'brug pa yab sras kyis// ma mo'i tshogs dbus gzir ba'i dus// ji ltar khas blangs= de ltar= da lta sngags 'chang 'khor bcas kyis// sgrub cing mchod pa byed pa'i dus// ji ltar= de ltar= ya mā ra tsa sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mañju shrī ya man ta ka ma ru tse te pa ta ye hūm̐/ lha tshogs de dag dregs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bran du khol ba'i byin dang ldan pa bsam la/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rngam pa'i me tog chu rigs khrug /bdug pa spos kyi na bun 'thul// mi bzad sgron me'i glog khem la// bsad pa'i dri chu char du bsnyil// sred gdung zhal zas myur gur bskyed// zhud pa'i sgra ni 'brug tu ldir// de ltas khyod mchod sprin gyi 'phreng*// mtha' klas nam mkha' 'gengs par rtsom// gzugs kyi mtshar sdug mig la ngom| /sgra dbyangs snyan po rna ba blugs// bsung zhim ngad pa sna la 'thul// ma mchu lce la bdud rtsir bshams// reg 'jam lus la 'khyud byar gnyer// de 'dra'i 'dod yon bu mo'i sde| /khyod thugs 'phrog pa'i gar stabs sbyor// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis// sbyangs rtogs sbar ba'i bdud rtsi'i sman// rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong*// dza gad phud sbyar gser skyems 'thor// mtshon cha ngar ma'i rno 'od kyis// dgra bgegs snying rnams zhu ba bzhin// bsgral ba stong gi khrag dmar rba// wu 'phreng can gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng*// ri dbang lta bur lhun chags shing*// chu gter bzhin du dkyil che la// nyi zla 'dra ba 'od gsal bas// 'dod dgur snang byed ba liṃ bshams// rnam kun mchog gi yul gyi mkhar| /'gyur med snying rje'i rdo rje bsrubs// khams gsum 'dod chags chen por bsgyur// mnyam nyid mchod pa'i dpyid du phul// oṃ ya man ta ka dza kha'i/

ya ma rā tsa hūm̐ kha'i| gu ya dz+nyā na yum kha'i/ ya ma ya tsa kha'i/ ma gshin tshogs kyi zhal du kha'i/ lan gsum gyis phul/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten lho yi phyogs skyong ba// bdag nyid chen po nyi ma'i bu| /'dod pa chags pa'i mgon po ste// gshin bu'i rje bo chos kyi rgyal// sku ni shin tu khred pa'i bongs// dus kyi me 'dra mdangs kyang mtshungs// srid pa gsum ni lto na chug /ral pa gzings pa'i gseb rnams nas// gshin rje pho 'bum mo 'bum 'gyed// gdangs pa'i spyan shangs zhal rnams las// dus mtha'i me rlung chu spros nas// dus mtha'i me rlung chu spros nas// 'jig rten khams rnams 'jig par mdzad// mche bzhis skye 'gro'i srog dbugs za// ba spu mtshon cha dug sprin las// dgra la dus min skal ngan 'gyed// bar na 'od kyi skar mda' ltung*// khrag 'thung rol pa bdud dgrar ston// bsam gyis mi khyab sprul pa'i dmag /rdo rje be con nang du rol// 'phyar bas bdud sde spa bkong zhing*// brgyab pas thal ba'i rdul du rlog /nga che nga 'jigs snyam pa yi// srid pa'i bdag po ma lus pa// ma tshor 'ching bas zhags pas 'dzin// sngar spyod ma 'dres kun snang ba'i// las kyi me long thugs ka'i rgyan// phas kyi rig sngags sreg pa'i me// ber gyon rin chen ska rags bcings// srid pa bkos la 'debs pa yi// khram shing chen po sked du gzer// sho yi sde snod glo la bcangs// dgra bgegs dmag tshogs kun gtor ba'i// rlung nag 'khrug pa'i slog pa gsol// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bdag nyid kyi// thod pa lngas ni cod pan mdzad// dgra mgo snying gi do shal can// gdug pa can gyi ltos 'gro dang*// gar gos rgyan gyi 'phreng bar bsrel// ljags 'dril mā ra ya bsgrags pas// khams gsum srid pa brdeg cing 'gul// bdud rgyal sa 'dzin 'khor bcas bred// lhag par sngangs te bub pa'i khar// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pas bzhugs// nad dang dmod pa ci yang gis// srid pa phung byed ma mo'i gtso// bdud kyi bu mo mgo 'phyang ma// dmar mo tsā muṇ+ḍi dang rol// khyod kyi shar nas 'gugs byed ging*// pra ma ra tsa srin po'i rgyal// ya byin ma dang lhan cig rtse// srin po'i dmag gis dgra bo 'joms// khyod kyi lho nas 'ching byed ging*// ya ma rā tsa gshin rje'i rgyal// de byin ma dang lhan cig rtse// gshin rje'i dmag gis=

khyod kyi nub nas gsod byed ging*// da sha gṛ ba bdud kyi rgyal// se byin ma dang lhan cig rtse// bdud kyi dmag gis= khyod kyi byang nas za byed ging*// yak+ṣa kā la gnod sbyin rgyal// phag byin ma dang lhan cig rtse// gnod sbyin dmag gis= bka' nyan las byed pho mo'i ging*// bye ba dung phyur zhud pa'i gzugs// cha byad mtshon cha srid dgu yis// bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms pa mdzad// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bstan srungs khyod la bdag cag gis// bstod pa'i dam pa bstod lags kyis// bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs// hūm̐/ de ring sngags 'chang bdag gis ni// byad ma rang la rang grub pa'i// 'chi bdag gshin rje khyod bskul gyis// bzhengs shig de yi ltag pa nas// dmar nag 'bar ba'i 'phreng bar 'khrug /gtum po ma rung ma he'i mgo /mi bzad rno ba'i mche gtsigs zhal// lus can kun gyi srog dbugs za// ljags dril gad rgyangs 'brug tu ldir| /spyan gsum dmar po'i glog 'khyug pas// sma ra smin ma skam skam 'bar// kham nag ral pa'i sprin gtibs nas// gshin rje 'bum ni char du 'bebs// 'bar ba'i rwa co'i gnam lcags lces// srid pa gsum gyi lto ba 'bigs// dpa' zhing rtul phod sgeg pa'i sku// ba spu khung nas dug rlangs khol// pho nya zhud can 'khyug tu 'gyed// rno ba'i ral gri mkha' la 'phyar// dgra bgegs kun gyi ske thag gcod// khrag zhags klad mtsho thod par 'thung*// gcir bu rgyan med rtags bsgreng ba// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rbad// srog zo dbugs 'goms bla khyer nas// dregs pa kun gyi mig la ngom// lus ngag yid gsum thal bar rlog /do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo// byad ma'i spyi bor 'thoms pa'i gshegs| /nga rgyal gshin rje dud 'gro'i rgyal// mthing nag du ra phag pa'i mgo /gtun shing khram baṃ 'dzin cing rngam// gcer bu rgyan med=

do nub sdang ba'i= srog zo dbugs= dregs pa kun= lus ngag yid= do nub gnod= byad ma'i mgrin par gsod pa'i gshed// dmar nag a ba glang gi mgo /tho ba me dpung 'dzin zhing hab// gcer bu= do nub= srog= dregs= lus= do nub gnod= byad ma'i snying gar srog gi gshed// ljang nag gdug pa sbrul gyi mgo /be con zhags pa 'dzin zhing dungs// gcer= do= srog= dregs= lus= do nub gnod pa'i= byad ma'i lte ba gcod pa'i gshed// ser nag rme tse khra yi mgo /bse mdung zhags pa bzung nas gzir// gcir bu rgyan med rtags bsgreng ba// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rbad// srog zo dbugs 'goms bla khyer nas// dregs pa kun gyi mi la ngom// lus ngag yid gsum thal bar rlog /do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo// hūm̐/ shin tu myur ba'i las mdzad tshe// lo brgyad khye'u khrag gi mdog /thung la gel zhing 'jigs pa'i sku// sha ral dmar pos gnya' ba bkab// gseb nas dug sbrul sdom sdig 'gyed// mdze rigs bco brgyad char du 'bebs// khro gnyer bsdus shing am gtsigs bsdams// spyan dmar sdang ba'i yul du gzir// gnam ru bdung zhing lcags mda' 'phen// me dang rlung gi slag pa gyon// chu glang dmar po smyon pa chibs// 'dre srin gshan pa zhub can ni// sna tshogs mtshon cha thod pas bskor// srid pa gsum gyi srog la rgyug /mi sha dmar po rjen pa za// mi khrag dron mo skom du 'thung*// sa gzhi gom pa gcig gis non// stong gsum skad cig yud kyis 'khor// zhud pa'i gzugs brnyan kun tu brdzu// sus kyang mi thub drag shul can// do nub rnal 'byor ngas bskul gyis// dam tshig nyams pa'i dgra la rgyug /zhag dang za mar gzhog mi rigs// myar du sgrol cig sa ma ya// de nas man ngag bzhin du bsnyen sgrub byas la/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ gtso bo yab yum dgyes par bsnyen lags pas// khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum bran du khol// zhi rgyas dbang drag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// 'phrin las 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// sku yi sprul pa pra ma rā tsa de// skye 'gro yongs kyi srid la mnga' mdzad pas// snang srid lo ka'i dpal rnams kun bsdus la// slob brgyud phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// yon tan sprul pa ya ma rā tsa de// skye 'gro kun gyi tshe dpal bdag po yin// srid pa gsum gyi tshe rnams kun bsdus// rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// gsung gi sprul pa da sha gṛ ba de| /skye 'gro rnams kyi srog la dbang bsgyur bas/

gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus tshar bcad de// drag po mthu yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// thugs kyi sprul pa yak+ṣa kā la de// 'jig rten khams kyi gter bdag chen po lags// zas nor longs spyod ma lus dbang bsdus nas// phun tshogs 'byor pa rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// 'phrin las sprul pa sring mo chen mo bzhi// 'jig rten kun la thogs med dbang mdzad de// mngon shes rkang mgyogs rig 'dzin bcud len sogs// thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// de nas tshogs bsangs sbyangs/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs te/ dang po mchod/ bar pa bshags/ tha ma gdab pa de ltar du bya ste/ hūm̐/ lha dang mi yi 'jig rten na// ro bcud dri mdangs rmad byung ba'i// bza' dang btung ba bldag gzhib kyis// tshogs mchod bsam gyis mi khyab pa// gzhi bdag las kyi gshin rjer 'bul// bzhes shig rol zhig kha raṃ khā'i// btsun mo tsā muṇ+ḍi la 'bul// bzhes shig= blon po ging chen bzhi la 'bul// bzhes shig= sring mo bal mo bzhi la 'bul// bzhes shig= bka' nyan ging tshogs yongs la 'bul| /bzhes shig= bar ma bshags pa 'bul ba ni// bdag cag mi shes gti mug pa'i// dbang gi chos kyi rgyal po khyod// 'khor bcas thugs la mi 'phrod pa// ci bgyis de la gnong zhing 'gyod// 'on kyang shad kyis sbyangs pas 'dag /de phyir khyod mdun mthol zhing bshags// phyin chad mi bgyid sdom par 'tshal// khro dang 'khang ba da ma mdzad// tha ma bdag las ni/ hoḥganam lcags grub pa'i 'brub khung 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i nang du/ nṛ tri las gnod byed 'byung po nyam chung zhing lus 'dar ba// mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can ngag tu sid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ mig nas mchi ma 'dzag cing bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa// lus la rma dang phol mig gis gang ba/ bshang gci 'chor ba mgon skyabs dang bral bar gyur// na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

sangs rgyas= chos kyi= dge 'dun= mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par gzhi bdag chen po las kyi gshin rje yab yum blon po bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis// spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra/ mched lcam dral gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams legs na mi dga' ba/ nyes na dga' ba/ mtho na mi dga' ba/ dma' na dga' ba/ mgo thog gi g.yam pa/ rkang 'og gi rde'u byed pa/ khog tu 'bu ltar g.yeng ba/ kha 'o ma las 'jam pa/ snying tsher ma las rtsub pa/ phod 'dzugs pa/ do bsdo ba/ yid gnag pa/ ru 'phyar bar byed pa'i dgra bo| /byad ma gnod byed/ bgegs gdon gang yin pa de thams cad steng 'og phyogs mtshams srid pa gsum ga na gnas kyang rang dbang med par skad cig yud cig thang cig la 'dir khug cig sarba sha truṃ big+nān ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥbadz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a/ hūm̐/ shar nas 'gugs byed ging chen po// srin po 'bum sde pho nyar khye| /sdig can bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di// rten la khug cig sha trūṃ dzaḥ lho nas 'ching byed ging chen po// gshin rje 'bum sde= mi bzad rdo rje'i zhags pa yis// chings shig sdoms shig ban+dha ya// nub nas gsod byed ging chen po// bdud po= mi bzad mtshon cha'i char phob la// myur du sod cig mā rā ya// byang nas za byed ging chen po// gnod sbyin= bsgral nas las gshin 'khor bcas kyi// zhal du stob cig kha raṃ khā'i// dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di zhes pa'i// gti mug sha dang 'dod chags khrag /zhe sdang rus dang nga rgyal zhag /phrag dog nang rol mchod par 'bul// hūm̐/ rwa brdar rmig pa sa la rdeb// rnga ma slong zhing kha rlangs me// ngar skad sa gzhis bzod dka' ba'i// glang dmar g.yag gis thugs dam bskang*// mchu sder zhud pa'i ma rungs bya// sha la gzhungs shing lding rnams dang*// srog gcod mtshon cha khar bsrel pa'i// gcan gzan gtum dgus=

khrag sna'i ar+ghaṃ gsur gyi dud// gser skyems gtor ma sha khrag rus// mar sbrang 'o ma la sogs pa'i// dgyes pa'i mchod pas= gang gis mi tshugs sra ba'i go /cis kyang mi thub rno ba'i mtshon// rtsub 'gyur tshal du bshams pa lta'i// spyan gzigs rgya mtshos= sa 'og yid dga'i nor bus gtams// sa gzhir rgyal srid sna bdun bstar| /sa blar bkra shis rdzas 'khrigs pa'i// 'dod yon kun gyis= bdud bcom chu srin rgyal mtshan bsgreng*// 'phyar dar ba dan rin chen gdugs// dra ba dra phyed mda' dar dang*| /lhab lhub lda ldis= thod tshal ras la bris pa dang*// dur khrod sa la byas pa'i sku /rabs chad thod par rang byung ba'i// bla rdo'i tshogs kyis= shir shing thog shing be dang sing*| /skyer pa'i be con phur bu dang*// ru mtshon ral gri mda' gzhu sogs// rten rdzas yongs kyis= lha bskyed sngags bzlas ting 'dzin gsal// dang por ma bkres bar ma sun| /tha mar ma skyengs ma khengs pa'i// dam tshig gnyan pos thugs dam bskangs// ya ma rā tsa sa pa wā re gats+tsha ces pas rten rnams rang gnas su gshegs su gsol// drag po'i las la bskul ba ni// hūm̐/ skye 'gro sgrol ba'i ging chen po// 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje khyod// drag po'i las la bskyod pa'i tshe// zas skom mi sha mi khrag ste// sku ni srid pa'i zom dang mnyam// 'jig rten gsum ni lte bar 'dzud// mthong tshad khrag tu skyugs nas 'chi// khams gsum za byed mthu bo che// gsung ni drag sngags dmod pa ste// thos tshad sngangs shing skrag pas brgyal// gzhan gyi las rnams 'joms pa dang*// gnod byed thams cad brlag par byed// thugs ni 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// chos nyid skye ba med pa'i rtsal| /ma rungs bdud 'dul las la rngam// bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad bsgrub// phyag na 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha kun// dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du 'phang*// brgyab tshad phog cing phog tshad 'chi// ming tsam min pa'i lhag mi 'jog

/'jig rten gom pa gsum gyis gnon// zhabs brdabs gnam sa sa 'og ldeg /srog chags gdug pa can la'ang chibs| /snang srid thams cad dbang du sdud// dregs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon// 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed po'i 'phrul// sprul pa ma he'i gdong brnyan can// nying 'phrul sgrol ging chen por ston// pho brgyud thams cad khyod kyi 'khor// mi bzad dmag dpung dgra la khye// yul 'khor nor rdzas brlag par gyis// mi brgyud chod la srog dbugs gsol// khyod dang sbyor ba byed pa'i yum// 'jig rten khams kyi mthu bo che// ma mo'i dbus na dbang bsgyur ma// phung byed chen mo tsā muṇ+ḍi// sngags bdag e ka dza ṭī'i 'phrul// sprul pa dmar mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka /nying 'phrul srid pa'i rgyal mor ston// mo brgyud thams cad= mi bzad dmag= yul 'khor nor= mi brgyud chod= khyod kyi shar phyogs blon po ni// pra ma ra tsa mthu bo che// thams cad 'gugs pa'i ging chen po// laṅka'i bdag po 'char ka'i 'phrul// sprul pa gza' bdud rā hu la// nying 'phrul mon bu ke tar ston// srin po thams= mi bzad= yul 'khor nor= mi brgyud= khyod kyi lho phyogs blon po ni// ya ma rā tsa dregs pa can// thams cad 'ching byed ging chen po// chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi 'phrul// sprul pa gshin rje ma ru tse// nying 'phrul gnod sbyin beg rtser ston// gshin rje thams cad= mi bzad= yul 'khor= mi brgyud= khyod kyi nub phyogs blon po ni// da sha gṛ ba drag shul can// thams cad gsod byed ging chen po// rta nag dregs pa chen po'i 'phrul// sprul pa trag shad nag po ste// nying 'phrul rgyal po sku lngar ston// bdud po thams cad= mi bzad= yul 'khor= mi brgyud= khyod kyi byang phyogs blon po ni// yak+ṣa kā lo stobs po che// thams cad za byed ging chen po// rgyal chen ngal bsos po yi 'phrul// sprul pa rdo rje bdud 'dul te// nying 'phrul yang le ber du ston// gnod sbyin thams cad=

mi bzad= yul 'khor= mi brgyud= blon po bzhi ni rol pa'i yum// rdo rje phur mo dbang mo dang*// rtsal mo stobs mo mched bzhi ste// nad gdon bgegs dang ltas ngan dang*// glo bur ye 'brog bdag mo ste| /re ti chen mo mched bzhi'i 'phrul// sprul pa sring mo bzhi po ste// nying 'phrul gdong mo bzhi ru ston// phra men ma mo thams cad 'khor// mi bzad= yul 'khor= mi brgyud= gzhan yang 'jig rten khyab pa'i ging*// glog khem tsam gyi yun tshad la// stong gsum chen po'i 'jig rten myul// srid gsum srog gi gshan pa ste// gtum po mtshon cha'i 'phrul 'khor mkhan// sdig dang nyon mongs drag po'i 'phrul// sprul pa dregs pa bco brgyad po// nying 'phrul las byed sde brgyad ston// mthong na skyi bung thams cad 'khor// mi bzad dmag dpung dgra la khye// yul 'khor nor rdzas rlag par gyis// mi brgyud chod la srog dbugs gsol// dpung bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ legs ldan 'dod chags mgon po yi// rdo rje'i be con khong seng nas// sprul pa'i dmag tshogs brdol ba ni// 'jig rten khams kyi rdul snyed de// stong nas dbyings kyi khro bo'i rgyal// 'jigs byed khrag 'thung rol pa'i tshogs// khros pa'i gar 'chams ci yang gis// dgra bo bsgral ba'i phung khams skye// tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol nas su// rnam shes ye shes bla mar bsgyur| /bar nas las mdzad sde brgyad dmag /mthong na drid dgu cir yang brdzu// mi shig rdo rje'i go gyon te// mthu stobs mtshon cha thogs nas su// bdud sde g.yul ngor rlag par byed// 'og nas dmyal srung gshan pa'i dmag /nyon mongs dug gi ngar ma rnams// dgra srog gcod pa'i gshed du chas/ sa 'og sa gzhi sa steng gar// dgra bgegs bla 'khyams rjes bsnyegs te// bsad nas sha dmar rjen par za// khrag rgyun dmar po hub kyis 'thung*// gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu lnga'i// dpung tshogs chen pos nam mkha' bkang*| /dregs pa'i bdag po bco brgyad ni// sder bcas zhub gyon sa la tshogs// kun kyang dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// byin rlabs nus pa'i byin dang ldan// de phyir sus kyang mi thub ste// dga' rab dbang phyug btsun mo dang*// blon po bzhir bcas dregs pa'i mthu// ma lus khyed kyis brlag par byed// do nub bdud kyi gshed du bskul// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rbad// dgra bo'i khang par dmag sgar 'chos// do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo// ma rungs sems can 'dul bar mdzod// de nas gser skyems gtor zhing*// hūm̐|

bdag gis ma nyes ma lan no// dus gsum sangs rgyas gzu dang dpang*// yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang*// dam can srung ma gzu dang dpang*// lha srin sde brgyad gzu dpang mdzod| /da ni bdag gi dgra 'di la// las gshin khros pa'i zor 'phar gis// steng gi lha la mi 'phen no// mtho ba rnams kyang zhabs skums shig /'og gi klu la mi 'phen no// dma' ba rnams kyang dbu chum zhig /bar gyi gnyan la mi 'phen no// lha srin sde brgyad sku gzur zhig /ko long gdug pa ma 'chang zhig /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs mdzod cig /zor 'phangs pa ni rim pa bzhin dang por dug zor thogs nas/ srin po'i dmag tshogs gdug pa can// cho 'phrul dug chu khol mar ston// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rgyob// do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la rgyob// sha ri bh+yo/ gshen rje'i dmag tshogs= cho 'phrul yungs thun 'bar bar ston// do nub= do nub= ma ri bh+yo/ ma mo'i dmag= cho 'phrul nad 'gyed khrag tu ston// do nub= do nub= khrag ma ma bh+yo/ gnod sbyin dmag= cho 'phrul gri mtshon 'bar bar ston| /do nub= do nub= tsir snying bh+yo/ bdud kyi dmag= cho 'phrul snying zor 'bar bar ston// do nub= do nub= snying bh+yo/ ma k+ṣi thod khrag dzaḥ /bal mo'i dmag= cho 'phrul rdo yi char du ston= do nub= do nub= khrag ti snying la ya/ 'gong po'i dmag= cho 'phrul 'phang zor shag stong ston// do nub= do nub= nri tri chod| klu gnyan= cho 'phrul dug rdog sna tshogs ston// do nub= do nub= nā ga chod/ yul lha'i= cho 'phrul mi kha'i sbyor ba dgu// do nub= do nub= mu lo chod| gza' skar= cho 'phrul dud dang bal phur ston// do nub= do nub= sha lo chod/ gdong mo'i= cho 'phrul khrag bcas spang skam ston// do nub= do nub= sha la kying kying bh+yo bh+yo/ dam can= cho 'phrul phur bu rtsang zor ston// do nub=

do nub= sa ma ya lha yi= cho 'phrul nyung zor mtshe zor ston// do nub= do nub= a ti pra ma ni mā ra ya zlog pho nya'i= cho 'phrul khrag kong zur gsum ston// do nub= do nub= pa ra bi dan tsin+dha tsin+dha bh+yo// ging bzhi'i= cho 'phrul gnam lcags mda' ru ston// do nub= do nub= ti phur shag bh+yo/ ti pur tsan+d+ra tsakra bh+yo/ ti pur me shum tsur ni bh+yo/ ti pur mā ra ya ni bh+yo/ de nas las kyi gshin rje'i zhal gtor lag tu thogs te/ hūm̐/ zlog sgyur mdzod cig stobs po che// khram kha sgyur cig mthu bo che// zor kha zlog cig drag shul can// bdud kha sgyur cig bzi brjid can// do nub srid pa'i khram kha sgyur// do nub lha 'dre'i dmag sna sgyur// gshin rje'i chad pa bdud kyi khram// ma mo'i dal kha btsan gyi rdo// srin po'i za res gnod sbyin tshub// klu yi byad bcug bza'i ki kang*// 'gong po'i phung sri rbad 'dre'i gnod// ban bon mu stegs byed la sogs// sngags mkhan nag po thams cad kyis// brtsams pa'i las kyi sbyor ba dang*// drag sngags dmod pa'i nus mthu sogs// mi mthun rkyen rnams dgra la zlog /ltas ngan ye 'brog gdon bgegs kyi// cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la sgyur// ma ma trak+sha mu tra snying kha rag thun bh+yo/ zlog zlog ni sha ku ru thun bh+yo zlog ces 'phang ngo*// de ltar/ gzhi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i 'phrin las dgra srog gcod pa'i spu gri zhes bya ba/ rgyal byed tshal du pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /maṅga laṃ/// /
